snippet.title: Let's play color game! Color Song for Kid
snippet.description:
🎵 〈What Color Is This? – Color Song for Kids〉

Hello kids, let's play a game!
Guess the color, say the name!

🔴 Red red, it's the red!
Round like apples, shiny red! 🍎
What color is this?
Red! Red!

🟡 Yellow yellow, it's so bright!
Long like bananas, full of light! 🍌
What color is this?
Yellow! Yellow!

🟢 Green green, fresh and clean!
Just like leaves, so cool and green! 🍃
What color is this?
Green! Green!

Colors, colors, what’s that hue?
What color? What color?
Look around and let’s all shout,
Can you find it? Point it out!

Can you find red?
Yes! There it is! 🔴
Let’s jump and clap! Clap clap!

🔵 Blue blue, sky so wide,
Fluffy clouds go float and glide! ☁️
What color is this?
Blue! Blue!

🟣 Purple purple, pop and drop,
Grapes that bounce and never stop! 🍇
What color is this?
Purple! Purple!

⚫ Black black, soft and neat,
A little kitty with sneaky feet! 🐱
What color is this?
Black! Black!

Colors, colors, let’s all play!
Point and clap, hooray hooray!
Time to party, time to dance!
Let’s all move and shake and prance!

Color time is so much fun!
Let’s all sing with everyone!

Red and yellow, mix them right,
You’ll get orange, warm and bright! 🎨
Blue and yellow, mix and swish,
You’ll get green – just like a dish!

Colors change, hooray surprise!
Look at magic with your eyes!

Let’s say colors one more time:
Red! Yellow! Green! Blue! Purple!

What color is the sun so high? 🌞
Yellow!
What color is the apple pie? 🍎
Red!

Colors, colors, we had fun~
What’s your favorite, everyone?
I like red! I like blue!
See you next time! Bye bye to you! 👋

snippet.description:
SuperHero Nursery Rhymes For Kids Song

🎵 "Five Little Superheroes" 🎵

Five little superheroes flying through the sky,
One zoomed left and took a dive!
Mama called the HQ, and they replied:
"No more flying, stay inside!"

Four little heroes with their capes so wide,
One spun ‘round and lost his glide.
Papa called the lab, and they all cried:
"No more flying, stay inside!"

Three little heroes in the clouds so high,
One got caught in a lightning sky.
Mama called the base, they sighed:
"No more flying, stay inside!"

Two little heroes zoomed past the moon,
One hit a pole—ouch! too soon!
Papa called the team, and they said tight:
"No more flying, not tonight!"

One little hero tried to take flight,
But he tumbled down from too much height.
Mama called the HQ, and they replied:
"Ground them all—no more flight!"

snippet.title: Let's play color game! Color Song for Kid
snippet.description:
🎵 〈What Color Is This? – Color Song for Kids〉

Hello kids, let's play a game!
Guess the color, say the name!

🔴 Red red, it's the red!
Round like apples, shiny red! 🍎
What color is this?
Red! Red!

🟡 Yellow yellow, it's so bright!
Long like bananas, full of light! 🍌
What color is this?
Yellow! Yellow!

🟢 Green green, fresh and clean!
Just like leaves, so cool and green! 🍃
What color is this?
Green! Green!

Colors, colors, what’s that hue?
What color? What color?
Look around and let’s all shout,
Can you find it? Point it out!

Can you find red?
Yes! There it is! 🔴
Let’s jump and clap! Clap clap!

🔵 Blue blue, sky so wide,
Fluffy clouds go float and glide! ☁️
What color is this?
Blue! Blue!

🟣 Purple purple, pop and drop,
Grapes that bounce and never stop! 🍇
What color is this?
Purple! Purple!

⚫ Black black, soft and neat,
A little kitty with sneaky feet! 🐱
What color is this?
Black! Black!

Colors, colors, let’s all play!
Point and clap, hooray hooray!
Time to party, time to dance!
Let’s all move and shake and prance!

Color time is so much fun!
Let’s all sing with everyone!

Red and yellow, mix them right,
You’ll get orange, warm and bright! 🎨
Blue and yellow, mix and swish,
You’ll get green – just like a dish!

Colors change, hooray surprise!
Look at magic with your eyes!

Let’s say colors one more time:
Red! Yellow! Green! Blue! Purple!

What color is the sun so high? 🌞
Yellow!
What color is the apple pie? 🍎
Red!

Colors, colors, we had fun~
What’s your favorite, everyone?
I like red! I like blue!
See you next time! Bye bye to you! 👋

snippet.description:
SuperHero Nursery Rhymes For Kids Song

🎵 "Five Little Superheroes" 🎵

Five little superheroes flying through the sky,
One zoomed left and took a dive!
Mama called the HQ, and they replied:
"No more flying, stay inside!"

Four little heroes with their capes so wide,
One spun ‘round and lost his glide.
Papa called the lab, and they all cried:
"No more flying, stay inside!"

Three little heroes in the clouds so high,
One got caught in a lightning sky.
Mama called the base, they sighed:
"No more flying, stay inside!"

Two little heroes zoomed past the moon,
One hit a pole—ouch! too soon!
Papa called the team, and they said tight:
"No more flying, not tonight!"

One little hero tried to take flight,
But he tumbled down from too much height.
Mama called the HQ, and they replied:
"Ground them all—no more flight!"
